views.text: In July 2023, a guest on Equity Mates said Jiumaojiu’s unit economics were particularly attractive for a restaurant box expansion model, implying strong per‑store profitability that enabled rapid growth compared to peers considered in China.

views.text: In July 2023, a guest on Equity Mates explained that in box expansion the test was how many profitable stores it took to fund a new one, and said Jiumaojiu’s economics supported reinvesting profits to open more locations quickly.
